newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Peregrine sets up office in southwest China.
newsitem.headline: Peregrine sets up office in southwest China.

text.p: Peregrine Capital Ltd has set up an office with Sichuan Xinan Investment Consulting Co Ltd in Chengdu, capital of southwest China province of Sichuan, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said on Thursday.
The newspaper quoted a Peregrine official as saying the firm would focus on helping Sichuan-based joint-stock firms raise funds through share issues abroad.

With the handover of Hong Kong to China in mid-1997, China's economy will see a new round of growth and Peregrine plans to use the office to extend its business to the whole of China's southwest, the official said at a ceremony in Chengdu, the province's capital, to mark establishment of the new office.
Sichuan, China's most populous province, ranks third in the number of joint-stock enterprises, after Shanghai and Shenzhen, the newspaper said.
Peregrine was international coordinator of Sichuan-based Chongqing Changan Automobile Co Ltd's offer of 250 million B shares, due to be listed in Shenzhen early November.
